task_summary: Customer reports that the SoundMax Basic Headphones from order ORD-6023 were damaged during shipping. The proper handling is to follow the shipping-damage process: review the shipping and return policy, refund the purchase price to the original payment method, provide a return label for the damaged item, and add a fragile-item goodwill credit only if applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.
